summary: MKBHD compares the Xiaomi 18 Fold with Apple's iPhone Duo, a folding phone with identical dimensions. He explains how the near-simultaneous unveilings can happen (supply-chain leaks, Xiaomi's speed). He then compares weight, battery, cameras, crease and foldable software behaviour such as multitasking and back-screen handling. The video ends with a plug for his own desk pad.
relevance_reason: This is a hardware comparison of foldable phones. Its only brush with the themes is brief remarks on foldable software and multitasking (two-app limit vs Android multi-window). It has no AI, personal-context, agent or voice content.

claims.claim: The iPhone Duo allows only two apps side by side, while Android foldables offer multi-window, bubble, overlay and triple-app multitasking, as if on a full-size tablet.
Android foldables treat closing as done and require a swipe or wake to continue on the outer display; the iPhone Duo lights the outer display mid-close for continuity.
Other foldables disable the back screen during selfies with the main cameras to prevent accidental touches; the iPhone Duo does not appear to do this.
Apple's software features leak less than hardware because they do not pass through the supply chain, so Apple can surprise people with software.
The Xiaomi 18 Fold is about 30 grams lighter than the 254 g iPhone Duo and has a 6,000 mAh silicon-carbon battery.

commercial_interest: He promotes his own MKBHD desk pad, made with Omnitype, at the end of the video. No sponsorship is evident for the phone content.
older_event: The video centers on the iPhone Duo and Xiaomi 18 Fold unveilings in early September 2026, about a month before the video date. The new element is the side-by-side comparison, which rests on specs and not on full reviews.
